evidence_excerpts: Table 2 reports matmul falling from 8.4 s to 2.4 s with slicing and 0.8 s with polytope evaluation, while fft falls from 920.7 s to 119.7 s with slicing and 110.5 s with polytope evaluation.
text: Interprocedural slicing and polyhedral loop evaluation substantially reduce loop-analysis time for many benchmarks while preserving safe loop-bound analysis.
